_comment: Employer boards to scrape. Every entry here was probed and verified to respond.
Add more freely — an unreachable board fails gracefully and yields 0 rows.
'hint' asserts what the board itself says about ship vs shore:
'ship'  = this board/site only ever posts shipboard (crew) roles
'shore' = this board/site only ever posts shoreside (office) roles
null    = mixed; common.classify_shipboard() decides per posting.
